participant_id.Description: Participant identifier, matching participants.tsv of the source dataset.

network.Description: Functional network targeted by the localizer task.

task.Description: Localizer task the statistical map comes from, matching the task entity of the source dataset.

Levels.AliceLocalizer: Language localizer based on the Alice in Wonderland listening task
Levels.MDLocalizer: Multiple-demand localizer based on a visual working-memory task

contrast.Description: First-level contrast the statistical map represents.

Levels.intact-degraded: Intact speech minus acoustically degraded speech (language localizer)

atlas.Description: Probabilistic group atlas of the target network against which the participant's map was correlated. The atlases are published by the Fedorenko laboratory (MIT) and are NOT redistributed with this dataset; see README.md for citations, download locations and md5 checksums of the exact files used.

Levels.Langloc_n806_top10%: Language atlas derived from 806 participants, thresholded at the top 10% of voxels (Lipkin et al., 2022)
Levels.MDloc_n691_top10%: Multiple-demand atlas derived from 691 participants, thresholded at the top 10% of voxels (Lipkin et al., 2022, online supplement)

r_atlas.Description: Pearson correlation between the participant's t-map and the probabilistic atlas of the same network, computed over all voxels where the t-map is finite and non-zero (the participant's whole-brain analysis mask). No Fisher transform is applied.

r_other_atlas.Description: Pearson correlation between the same t-map and the atlas of the other network, computed identically. Serves as a specificity check: a network-specific map correlates more strongly with its own atlas than with the other one.

note.Description: Free-text note about the participant's map; 'n/a' where no note applies.

statmap.Description: Path of the statistical map the correlation was computed on, relative to the root of this derivative dataset.

CorrelationMethod.Description: For each participant map S and atlas A, the Pearson correlation between the t-statistic values of S and the probability values of A, taken over all voxels where S is finite and non-zero (approximately 200,000-238,000 voxels per participant). The t-map (spmT) is used rather than the contrast image, correlations are not Fisher-transformed, and no additional masking or thresholding is applied. Maps and atlases share the same 91x109x91, 2 mm grid, so no resampling is involved.

Atlases.Name: Langloc_n806_top10%
Atlases.Citation: Lipkin, B., Tuckute, G., Affourtit, J., et al. (2022). Probabilistic atlas for the language network based on precision fMRI data from >800 individuals. Scientific Data, 9, 529.

Atlases.Name: MDloc_n691_top10%
Atlases.Citation: Lipkin, B., Tuckute, G., Affourtit, J., et al. (2022). Probabilistic atlas for the language network based on precision fMRI data from >800 individuals. Scientific Data, 9, 529. Multiple-demand atlas distributed in the online supplement.
